name: talember
description: A simple OpenRouter-directed photo and story to video service using PayPal and fal.ai.

scripts.build: npm run build:client && WRANGLER_WRITE_LOGS=false WRANGLER_SEND_METRICS=false WRANGLER_SEND_ERROR_REPORTS=false CLOUDFLARE_LOAD_DEV_VARS_FROM_DOT_ENV=false wrangler deploy --dry-run --env-file /dev/null --outdir dist
scripts.db:local: WRANGLER_WRITE_LOGS=false WRANGLER_SEND_METRICS=false CLOUDFLARE_LOAD_DEV_VARS_FROM_DOT_ENV=false wrangler d1 migrations apply TALEMBER_DB --local --env-file /dev/null
scripts.dev: npm run build:client && WRANGLER_WRITE_LOGS=false WRANGLER_SEND_METRICS=false CLOUDFLARE_LOAD_DEV_VARS_FROM_DOT_ENV=false wrangler dev --local --env-file /dev/null
